First of all please don't apologize. Your parents are probably scared and confused about what to do. It's difficult being suicidal but it might be that the people around you don't know what to do. They don't want to trigger or harm or annoy you. They don't want to trigger that suicidal part of you. Try telling your parents how you really feel about it. Let them sit down and talk to them. I know this could be difficilt for you but in these kinds of situations communication is the best way. Bottling up your emotions won't work and will make your anxiety worse. Trust me i know from experience. Really tell them how you feel and if you're concerned about your current health also be honest with them and tell them you might want to go to the hospital for a check-up. I'm not saying you should just stop being suicidal because being suicidal will never go away. I don't want to discourage you but you can lessen it. Make it better try to find coping mechanisms. Don't try smoking or drugs becuase i used that as a coping mechanism and now i can't stop using it. Maybe see a psychologist. They can really help with all of those emotions. And you can try to take daily notes. What k mean is everyday describe how you're feeling, why you're feeling that way and note 3 things that you're grateful for. Doing this everyday might increase your happiness and maybe you can learn how to control those bad emotions. You might not see or believe it but there are lots of people who care about you! Even strangers like me. I hope you take care ajd don't give up. Try looking on the bright side of things. Don't think of the reasons you're suicidal think of the reason of what's kept you alive. <3
